# Royal collectibles and the secret ending

- Original source: [Royal collectibles and the secret ending](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=792309796)
- Author / publication: xXDylanXWithinXx / Steam Community
- Language / date: English; published 2016-11-02; updated 2022-06-01
- Access: Full guide page retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: none found in the Wayback Machine (checked 2026-09-09)
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete factual notes (no redistribution grant on Steam guides, so not transcribed)

The guide maps royal objects to missions:

| Mission | Royal object |
| --- | --- |
| The Prince and the Outlaw | Sceptre |
| The Evening Visitor | Domesday Book |
| The Lock-up and the Friar | Coronation Spoon |
| The Silver Arrow | Sword of State |
| A Wedding and a Funeral | Ampulla |
| The Escape | Royal seal |
| The Letter | Crown |

Some pickups require dialogue progression, a particular guard's defeat, or beggar information. Consult the original for locations.

**Terminology caution:** its numbering includes the Silver Arrow alongside royal regalia. The scoring guide treats them differently. Ending-condition code was not verified.

## Detailed notes

Guide metadata at retrieval: posted 2 Nov 2016 2:02pm, updated 1 Jun 2022 3:11pm; 33 ratings; categories Secrets, Story or Lore, Walkthroughs; 2,121 unique visitors, 43 favourites, 11 comments; signed "El Huevo". A Russian translation by another user was published in October 2025 (Steam file id 3589535751) with the author's permission. Each item section is illustrated with screenshots hosted on images.steamusercontent.com; the steps for the Ampulla are given only as an image, so they are not captured here.

**Introduction.** Royal items are optional secondary objectives in some castle levels; collecting them unlocks a secret ending. Levels with collectables: The Prince and the Outlaw, The Evening Visitor, The Lock-up and the Friar, The Silver Arrow, A Wedding and a Funeral, The Escape, The Letter.

**Item locations as described.**
1. "Royal rod" (sceptre), The Prince and the Outlaw, Derby castle: after Robin and Marian discover Prince John's betrayal in the meeting room, a previously inaccessible room to the right of the castle opens; the rod is next to the guards there.
2. Domesday Book ("Doomsday book"), The Evening Visitor, Ranulph's castle in Leicester: unlocked after the main objective of telling Ranulph about the betrayal; Ranulph mentions it; guarded by the sheriff's soldiers, who may be killed; in the south-east tower, the same tower where Will Scarlet was imprisoned.
3. Coronation spoon, The Lock-up and the Friar: dropped by the red knight at the top of the Derby tower above the meeting room; only obtainable after defeating him.
4. Silver Arrow, The Silver Arrow, Nottingham: the tournament prize was bait and is never awarded, but it lies in the castle next to the jail cell, protected by two spearmen and a red knight.
5. Sword of State, same mission: in Nottingham's church, heavily guarded by soldiers and knights. Both items are available from the start of the mission in any order.
6. Ampulla ("crystal phial"), A Wedding and a Funeral, south York: a black officer talks to a woman outside her house; her jealous husband keeps interrupting, and the pair hide inside until he leaves. The required steps are shown in a screenshot; the author warns to be quick because she leaves right after the husband is gone or knocked down; then take down the officer and pick up the phial.
7. Royal seal, The Escape, Nottingham: after freeing Robin, sneak into the king's room and fight a single red knight.
8. Royal crown, The Letter: a beggar above the contact Allan, if paid enough, sends you to York's church, where a stack of money and the crown are found; described as one of the last items needed for the secret ending and 100% completion.

**Comment thread.** Mostly thanks (2021–2025); the author notes some items are very easy to miss.
